seams.progress: Measured current storage economics. One semantic Hint JSON is p50 1,437 B / p99 27,784 B / max 574,971 B. A local path+single-event document is p50 1,892 B / max 3,440 B. But published-level encodeHints hint arrays are p50 1,149,023 B / p99 2,044,991 B / max 5,269,927 B before level metadata and Firestore overhead. Thus 5/1000/5000 path-count caps are not principled capacity contracts. Local storage additionally cannot retain same-path rediscovery provenance and has no import-to-git convergence path. Implementation needs bounded/sharded event growth plus explicit byte preflight/overflow semantics, not silent truncation.
